text:
kai: Heads-up — onboarding partner account `lumen-ops` in asia-southwest1. They need GPU capacity for an upcoming benchmark: ~8 p5 instances, 12 g5s, and 2 p4d, across 2 AZs. Also need ENI/IPv4 increases. Target date: 2026-04-06 (two weeks). Can someone drive quota requests and prebook capacity?
maria: Assigning to Alex to file requests + get TAM looped in. Cost center: CC-5102, billing alias: lumen-ops-redwood.
alex_devops: Starting checklist — region: asia-southwest1 (non-standard), account id 987654321012. I'll open Service Quotas + Support case. Quick Q: do we want On-Demand or reserved pool?
kai: Prefers on-demand with burst to reserved if they stabilize. For now ask for on-demand ceiling and request p5/p4d capacity reservations as a fallback. Also bump ENI per-instance and total ENI quota for the account.
taylor_infra: Noted networking constraints from prior onboards — this region has tight VPC ENI + EIP limits. Recommend requesting: EC2 AcceleratorQuota (p5/p4d/g5), ElasticNetworkInterfaces quota + VPC IPs, and NAT Gateway EIP quota bump.
alex_devops: Filing support case now. Copy of payload I'm sending to AWS:```
Subject: URGENT - Accelerator and ENI quota increases for account 987654321012 in asia-southwest1
Body: Hello, we are Redwood Inference onboarding a partner account (987654321012). Production workload requires:
- p5 instance quota: 8 (current 0)
- g5 instance quota: 12 (current 2)
- p4d instance quota: 2 (current 0)
- Elastic Network Interfaces: 300 (current 50)
- Elastic IPs: 50 (current 5)
Rationale: benchmarking & initial production for latency-sensitive workload. Expected steady-state: ~6 p5 / 8 g5. Time-sensitive: need increases in 10-14 days. Linked billing/cost center: CC-5102.
Please escalate to Capacity team and confirm availability and timeline.
Regards, Alex (Redwood Inference)
```
Posting now — will paste case id once created.
sre-bot: Support case created: 1234567890. Status: pending AWS TAM assignment. Estimated initial review: 48 hrs.
aws_tam: Hi team — I'm your TAM. Capacity in asia-southwest1 is constrained for p5 right now. We can submit a capacity reservation request to the regional Capacity Team but will need PO/usage forecast + willingness to accept cross-AZ placement. Do you have forecasted vCPU-hours or concurrency?
maria: We'll provide a short forecast doc. Rough peak: 480 vCPU-hours/day for first month (bench + steady runs), spike windows during business hours. We'll email a spreadsheet.
alex_devops: AWS asked for placement flexibility. I'll also open a dedicated request for a Capacity Reservation for 8 p5 equivalent nodes and ask to pre-approve fallback to g5 when p5 unavailable.
kai: Also request ENI tagging rules and subnet prep: make sure subnets have /20s. We had a previous failure due to small subnets.
taylor_infra: Reminder to request IAM limits if they create many node roles. Also open quota for ENI per instance type — p4d/p5 have higher per-instance ENI values.
alex_devops: Update: case 1234567890 -> escalated to Capacity Team. TAM requested attached spreadsheet + proposed timeline; I uploaded it. AWS suggests temporary soft limit of p5=4 approved in 72h, full approval subject to capacity confirmation.
maria: If soft limit only 4, we should plan canary tests with 4 p5 + supplement g5s. Any ETA on ENI/EIP increases?
aws_tam: ENI/EIP quota increases processed: Elastic IPs -> 50 approved; ENI total -> 320 approved. ETA: immediate. P5 soft raise to 4 is provisioned; Capacity Team will advise on full 8 within 5 business days.
sre-bot: Notification: Quota changes applied to account 987654321012: EIP=50, ENI=320.
alex_devops: I've updated the onboarding checklist and Terraform var file with the new quotas and temporary limits. Example snippet:```hcl
provider "aws" { region = "asia-southwest1" }
resource "aws_instance" "benchmark_p5" { instance_type = "p5.48xlarge" count = 4 }
```
kai: Good. Let's also add a fallback routing policy in Redwood control plane to route to g5-gpu capacity in eu-south-1 if p5 capacity falls short during the initial 2-week window. Keep customers on latency-SLA degrade path.
taylor_infra: I opened an internal ticket to reserve some g5 spare capacity in eu-south-1 as a cross-region fallback. Cost estimate: worst-case cross-region routing adds ~12% to token cost (egress + longer runtime). Need approval from finance for temporary bump.
maria: I'll ping finance for a small temporary budget increase.
alex_devops: Final note: once Capacity Team confirms full approval, we'll request AWS to convert soft quota to permanent 8 p5 and update service-quotas records. I'll close support case after confirmation.
sre-bot: Case 1234567890 status updated: Capacity Team scheduled a review for 2026-04-01.
kai: Thanks everyone. If anything blocks, @alex_devops escalate and ping me. We'll run canary benchmark next Tue with the 4 p5 + g5 spillover. :thumbsup:
